messages:
Lila (People Ops): FYI Paulina submitted notice earlier today, last day Thu 4/15. We need to coordinate benefits end date, HSA rollover instructions, device return, and deprovision schedule. Sam can you own the KT plan?
Paulina Ramos: thanks all. Last day is correct. prefer a prepaid ship label for the MacBook. also curious about HSA -- will that stay with me?
Sam (Eng Manager): I'll schedule two 90-min handoff sessions next week and a short doc checklist. will tag owners on active issues.
Priya (IT): noted. options for device: 1) FedEx prepaid label (we email it) or 2) SF office drop. will open ticket and queue the remote wipe for 4/15 18:00 PT after confirm.
Marisol (Payroll): final paycheck includes prorated salary + unused PTO payout. We'll run it on payroll cycle 4/30 so funds hit 5/1. Please confirm bank on file.
Paulina Ramos: bank is same as payroll; use paulina.personal@mail.com for final tax forms and COBRA.
Lila (People Ops): COBRA packet goes out to that email on 4/16. coverage termination is 4/30 (end of month), COBRA election window 60 days. HSA: the HSA account is portable and remains in your name; opt-in/transfer instructions linked in the packet.
Alex (Security): security checklist: revoke Okta MFA, remove project IAM roles, rotate any service account keys Paulina could access. Compliance Bot will flag any export-controlled repo access for manual review.
Compliance Bot: alert: Paulina has access to proj-quant-research. Please confirm that data artifacts are handled per TOC export controls before deprovision.
Sam (Eng Manager): good catch. I'll work with Paulina on scrub/export notes and hand off dataset ownership.
Priya (IT): created ticket IT-9127: device return + SSO deprovision + GDrive ownership transfer. Scheduled deprovision 2026-04-15 18:00 PT.
Oncall Bot: reminder queued: remove Paulina from PagerDuty at 18:05 PT on 2026-04-15.
Alex (Security): Paulina, please list any external infra creds you maintain (AWS keys, Docker Hub tokens, CI service accounts) so we can rotate them. If you can't, we'll rotate on our side after deprovision.
Paulina Ramos: list in DM sent to Alex. I'll revoke any personal tokens prior to last day.
Marisol (Payroll): note about benefits: dental/vision end same day as medical (4/30). COBRA payments due within 60 days of election; Marisol will send plan rates in the packet.
Lila (People Ops): exit interview is voluntary; we'll send a calendared 30-min slot. also reminder: post-employment IP/NDA obligations still apply per offer letter.
Sam (Eng Manager): I'll reassign Paulina's oncall rotations and mark her PRs for handoff. tagging @team to pick owners for the remaining backlog.
Priya (IT): sample deprovision commands (internal):
```
# revoke okta session
oktactl sessions revoke --email paulina.ramos@redwood.ai
# remove ssh keys
gcloud compute os-login ssh-keys remove --key-file=/home/paulina/.ssh/authorized_keys
```
Alex (Security): also will rotate KMS keys for project-quant-research after compliance confirms artifact status.
Paulina Ramos: thanks everyone. I'll complete the IT checklist and drop the laptop in the FedEx box when the label arrives.
Marisol (Payroll): expense reimbursement: submit outstanding expenses within 30 days of termination for processing.
Lila (People Ops): closing loop: people-ops will send COBRA + HSA docs on 4/16, IT to run deprovision 4/15 18:00 PT, security/compliance to confirm dataset scrub, payroll to process final pay 4/30. please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
